mentions.name: Open-source Zelda-like game engine
mentions.description: This open-source game engine lets users build and play Zelda-like games, with roughly 1000 custom fangames created with it. Recent work rewrites the engine from single-screen play areas to free-scrolling, adds cross-platform support (Windows, Mac, Linux, Web), and includes a deterministic record-and-replay testing system, a garbage collector for its custom scripting language, JIT compilers for x64 and WASM, and a VS Code language server. The current goal is polishing for the next major official release.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've spent a considerable amount of my free time over the last few years working on an open-source game engine for making Zelda-like games (link in profile).
